subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He pressed the ________ just in time to avoid the accident.
solution:
The correct answer is '**brake**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**brake**" refers to a device for slowing or stopping a moving vehicle, typically by applying friction. (वाहन को धीमा या रोकने का उपकरण)
 
• Pressing the brake is the action taken to prevent an accident.
 
• The other options: "**bike**," "**break**," and "**beak**" do not fit the context of avoiding a car accident.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *He pressed the brake__ just in time to avoid the accident.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bike (बाइक)**: refers to a bicycle or motorcycle.
 
• **Break (ब्रेक)**: means to separate or cause to separate into pieces or to interrupt a continuous action.
 
• **Beak (चोंच)**: the horny projecting mouth of a bird, turtle, or some other animals.
